title: Shipping
summary: Free US shipping on orders over $75
body: Free US shipping on orders over $75, otherwise $6.95. Standard delivery 3-6 business days. Express $14.95 (2 business days). International shipping to the UK, Canada and Australia: $19.95, 7-14 business days. Orders ship within 1-2 business days. Payment: pay by card at checkout, or choose cash on delivery for US orders and pay the courier in cash when your order arrives. Cash on delivery needs a phone number so the courier can contact you.

title: Returns & exchanges
summary: Free US returns within 30 days of delivery
body: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery for unworn items with tags attached. US returns are free with a prepaid label; international customers pay return shipping. Exchanges for a different size or color are free, subject to stock. Final sale (cannot be returned): Crew Socks (3-pack) and Gift Cards.

title: Refunds
summary: Refunds to your original payment method in 5-7 business days
body: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the warehouse receives the item. For cash on delivery orders, we refund by bank transfer or store credit, whichever you prefer. Damaged or wrong items get a full refund or a free replacement.

title: Cancellations
summary: Cancel any time before your order ships
body: Orders can be cancelled while they are still processing (before they ship). Once shipped, use a return instead.

title: Support hours
summary: AI assistant 24/7, people on weekdays 9am-6pm ET
body: Human support: Monday-Friday, 9am-6pm Eastern Time. The AI assistant is available 24/7.
